name: Being Responsible
overview: Scripture emphasizes personal responsibility as a vital aspect of the believer's life, teaching that each person must give an account of themselves before God and bear their own burdens (Romans 14:12; Galatians 6:5). Faithfulness in small matters reflects one’s integrity in greater responsibilities (Luke 16:10), while confession and forsaking of sin are necessary for mercy and prosperity (Proverbs 28:13). Additionally, responsibility extends to training others in righteousness (Proverbs 22:6) and recognizing that each soul is accountable for its own sin, not the sins of another (Ezekiel 18:20).
